events.body:
## Context

BLT-Flutter (`blt-flutter/`) is rated **Bronze** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-flutter): it meets 93% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Silver (it runs: tests in CI, an automatic deploy, a live site and steps to run it)

- **README shows how to run it.** Add a "Run locally" (or Install / Getting started) section to the README with the exact commands in a code block, including how to run the tests.

## Notes

- The Google Play (`id=org.owasp.blt`) and App Store (`id6450837545`) links on flutter.owaspblt.org return 404, and the app's own IDs differ (Android `com.apps.blt`, iOS `com.krrishsehgal.blt`). Publish the app or replace the buttons with the release build links.
- `release-artifacts.yml` uses the deprecated `actions/upload-artifact@v2`.
- The README's licence link points at github.com/OWASP/BLT-Flutter; use the monorepo folder.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] README shows how to run it
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-flutter` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-flutter
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-flutter
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
